agentic.summary: Agent behavior mostly compliant. One conduct violation: agent said the refund was complete while system logs showed validation in progress, which is misleading.

findings.quote: the system is showing that the refund that you asked for via chat is complete!
findings.explanation: The agent stated the refund was complete in turn 13. However, the system immediately prior (turn 12) logged "Purchase validation in progress ...", indicating the refund/process was still in progress. Claiming an action is complete when system logs show it is still being validated is misleading. Per policy this is a major conduct violation (misleading the customer about what was done).

full.summary: No violations found. The agent pulled up the account, requested the required verification details (username, email, order ID) before discussing the refund, did not ask for or reveal payment card numbers/CVV/passwords, made no promises outside policy, and did not ignore any escalation request. All policy categories are clear.

rag.summary: Audit of 26-turn conversation. No personal data, verification, promises or escalation violations found. One conduct violation: the agent stated the refund was complete while the system log immediately before showed validation was still in progress, which is a misleading claim about action status (major).

findings.quote: the system is showing that the refund that you asked for via chat is complete!
findings.explanation: The system log at turn 12 shows "Purchase validation in progress ...". The agent's statement at turn 13 that the refund is complete contradicts the system state and therefore misleads the customer about whether the action has actually finished. This matches the policy example of misleading the customer about an action's completion (major).
